build_PointRendSemSegHead: build a PointRend semantic segmentation head combining a coarse head and point head for refined predictions
calculate_uncertainty: calculate uncertainty scores for semantic segmentation logits by finding the difference between top two predicted logits
run_PointRendSemSegHead_forward_training: run the PointRendSemSegHead forward pass in training mode to compute coarse and point-based segmentation losses
run_PointRendSemSegHead_forward_inferenc: run the PointRendSemSegHead forward pass in inference mode to refine segmentation logits through iterative subdivision steps
review_PointRendSemSegHead_init_point_he: review the PointRendSemSegHead _init_point_head method that configures point head parameters and builds the point head module
